description:
Commits the runner smoke record of the story's benchmark arms, which establishes each arm's wire contract.

## Background

The gf2 arms of the LDPC batch decoder and the AFF3CT arms [Cassagne2019] are built or catalogued under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` and `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms.json`. Their build identity and validation records are under `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/`. The shared runner's smoke drives one untimed dispatch per arm in the validation position. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `benchmark-ab-runner smoke` over a throwaway plan passes each arm with one untimed dispatch and no timing window.
- [hard] REQ-02: The smoke record is committed as `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/smoke.json` and names each arm by the digest of the build identity record.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Smoke the benchmark arms through the shared runner
